doc: A field object's own sound when it is used (M3-AUD-864, the Act I foley detail pass; game/audio/interact_audio.gd, InteractAudio, built by the Audio autoload). by_id: "<location_id>:<interactable id>" (the layout's trigger id) or a bare id -> an sfx row, played at the object height_m over its floor, over ui_sfx.json's soft ui_interact touch. Objects whose use opens a cutscene (its @sfx and foley), a battle, a shop, a shrine or a trial (AshcrownAudio, the Coilspire's coilspire_sfx.json) have no row here.
